title: Path modifiers and non-destructive geometry
summary: Transform a path through a reusable modifier chain without permanently changing its source contours.

blocks.text: Path retains source contours and evaluates an ordered modifier stack into a derived contour set. A modifier has identity, enabled state and dirty tracking. Changing its properties invalidates evaluation; modifying private arrays behind that contract may not. Source and evaluated contours let downstream code choose whether to inspect canonical or rendered geometry.

cells: Select, reverse or split visible contour ranges
Change sampling density or corner shape

blocks.text: Reordering the same modifiers can change the result: trimming before resampling is different from resampling the whole curve and then trimming it. Closed contours need continuity at the seam; open contours may preserve endpoints.

Implement IPathModifier or extend PathModifierBase. Work in PathContours and retain the contour representation expected by the renderer. Return a valid evaluated contour collection, bump version when mutable configuration changes, and avoid changing the retained source in place. CustomModifier is suitable for a focused functional transformation.
